cues.en: If you're like most people, you've been using base 10 to count things since before you learned what numbers are. Decimal is by far the most common numbering system, but in many ways, it's clearly not the best way to count things. The number 10 was chosen completely arbitrarily based on the number of fingers most people have. But when you think about it, there are other numbers that would work much nicer as a base. This is dozenal, a system that counts by twelves instead of by tens. All you need is two extra digits for ten and eleven, and then you write 12 with one zero. The standard among mathematicians for writing larger bases is to extend the Arabic numerals using the Latin alphabet. So 10 is written with the letter a, and 11 is written with the letter b. But, actually, doing it that way makes ten and eleven look like they're two separate from the rest of the digits, so you can use an inverted two for 10 and an inverted three for 11. But those don't display on most fonts, so you can approximate them with the letters t and e, which also happen to be the first letters of the English words ten and eleven. But, actually, as long as we're okay with using the Latin alphabet to represent these digits, then we might as well use x for 10, like in Roman numerals. But, actually, now we're back to having them look too different from the other 10 digits. So how about instead we use the Greek letters chi and epsilon, but actually, if we're using Greek letters, then there's no association between the x looking letter and the number 10. So maybe you can write 10 with the Greek letter delta instead. And all you really need to learn is those two new digits, and you're ready to use dozenal. The first thing that's great about dozenal is that it's already common in some contexts, like if you're counting eggs or pastries or inches.

cues.zh: 五十一、五十二、五十三、渴四、五十五。这里有个很妙的对应关系：数到五之后，你需要用另一只手；而数到五之后，你需要进一位。现在，你熟悉十二进制了，你可能见过一种用手指数十二进制的方法，就是在手指的12个指节上数，而不是在五根手指上数。没错，这样一只手能数到12，但仔细想想。想想你最可能用手指计数的情况，也就是你需要向别人直观展示数字信息的时候。在正常的手指计数法中，数字四看起来是这样，数字五看起来是这样。它们清晰可辨，任意两对手指数字也一样。在十二进制计数法中，数字四看起来是这样，数字五看起来是这样。你能诚实地说，你能在远处始终分辨出这两种手势吗？我知道我做不到。还值得一提的是，如果你愿意，可以把每根手指当作一个独立的二进制位，这样两只手能数到一千多。当然，如果你像我一样，小指无法独立于无名指活动，这就会遇到问题。好。那我之前说的除法是怎么回事？第三部分。六是反质数。数字12的因数比任何小于12的数都多，这使它成为高度合数。问题是，还有一类更酷的高度合数子集，因数更多。

cues.en: These are the superior highly composite numbers, and not only do they have more factors than all the numbers smaller than themselves, they also have more factors than all the numbers larger than themselves, if you adjust for magnitude somewhat. SHCNs are an elite group, and they don't let just anyone in. They're in many ways the opposite of prime numbers. Since they have so many dang factors, anti prime bases are really good. Among them are numbers like 60 used for timekeeping, and 360
cues.zh: 这些是高度复合数的佼佼者，它们不仅比所有比自己小的数字拥有更多因数，如果你按量级稍作调整，它们甚至比所有比自己大的数字拥有更多因数。SHCN 堪称精英群体，门槛极高。它们在很多方面与质数截然相反。既然它们有那么多该死的因数，反质数基底自然非常好用。其中包括像用于计时的 60，以及 360

cues.en: used for angle measure, and 5,040,
cues.zh: 用于角度测量，还有 5,040，

cues.en: Plato's favorite. And, yes, both six and twelve. Let's step back for a moment and talk about divisibility tests. I don't know about you, but when I was in school, I had to use divisibility tests for decimal all the time. Looking at the last digit of a number only tells you what factors it has in common with 10. But that's not the only divisibility test that exists. You can generalize divisibility tests in any given base into two infinite families. The first type is the simpler one. If the last x digits of n in base b share a factor with b to the x, then n also shares that factor with b to the x. So, in decimal, if the last digit is even, the whole number is even, because two is a factor of 10. And if the last two digits are zero zero, two five, five zero, or seven five, the whole number is divisible by 25, because 25 is a factor of 10 squared. The second type of divisibility test is a bit more complicated. If you take the digits of N in base b and group them into substrings of length x, and add all those substrings together, the number N shares a factor with b to the x minus one if and only if that sum shares the same factor.
cues.zh: 柏拉图的最爱。没错，还有 6 和 12。我们暂且退一步，来谈谈整除性检验。我不知道你怎么想，但我在学校时，总是得对十进制进行整除性检验。观察一个数字的最后一位，只能告诉你它和 10 有哪些共同因数。但这并非世上唯一的整除性检验方法。你可以将任意给定进位制的整除性检验推广为两个无限大家族。第一种类型相对简单。如果在 $b$ 进位制下 $n$ 的最后 $x$ 位与 $b^x$ 共享一个因数，那么 $n$ 也与 $b^x$ 共享该因数。因此，在十进制中，如果末尾数字是偶数，整个数就是偶数，因为 2 是 10 的因数。如果末尾两位是 00、25、50 或 75，整个数就能被 25 整除，因为 25 是 10 的平方的因数。第二种整除性检验稍微复杂一些。如果你把 $b$ 进位制下的数 $N$ 的数字按长度 $x$ 分组为子字符串，并将所有这些子字符串相加，那么当且仅当该和与 $b^x$ 减一共享某个因数时，数 $N$ 才与该因数共享。

cues.en: So, in decimal, if you add the digits of a number together, the result can tell you what factors the original number has in common with 10 minus one, which is nine. If you do the same thing but instead of adding the digits, you add pairs of digits, you can see what factors the original number has in common with one less than 10 squared, which is 99.
cues.zh: 所以，在十进制中，如果你把一个数字的各位数字相加，其结果可以告诉你这个原数与 10 减 1（即 9）有什么共同的因数。如果你做同样的操作，但不是相加各个数字，而是相加每对数字，你就能看出原数与 10 的平方减 1（即 99）有什么共同的因数。

cues.en: 99 is divisible by nine, and we already have a divisibility test for that, so dividing that out, we're left with 11. And would you look at that, 11 is exactly one more than 10. This will happen in any base, because for any number n, n squared minus one equals n plus one times n minus one. Neat. Recap, in any given base, there's easy divisibility tests for factors of the base and doable divisibility tests for factors of the numbers adjacent to the base. This doesn't just apply to divisibility tests, it's also reflected in the representations of rational numbers. In decimal, a half is written as point five, because it's equal to five tenths. In decimal, a half is written as point six, because it's equal to six twelfths. In seximal, a half is written as point three, because it's equal to three sixths. Three doesn't evenly go into 10, but it does evenly go into nine. In decimal, a third is written as point three recurring, because it's equal to three ninths. In decimal, a third is written as point four, because it's equal to four twelfths. In seximal, a third is written as point two, because it's equal to two sixths. Four doesn't evenly go into 10, but that's fine because a fourth is just half of a half. In decimal, one half is point five, and half of five is two and a half, 2.5. So one fourth is point two five. In decimal, a fourth is written as point three because it's equal to three twelfths. Four doesn't evenly go into six, but that's fine, because a fourth is just half of a half. In seximal, one half is point three, and half of three is one and a half, 1.3. So one fourth is point one three. At this point, there's a very clear ranking for which bases are better at rational numbers than which other bases. Dozenal is the simplest, writing all three of these fractions with just one digit, followed by seximal, which needs two digits to write fourths, and in last place is decimal, which writes thirds with a recurring digit. This ranking becomes less obvious if we take fifths into account. In decimal, a fifth is written as point two because it's equal to two tenths. Five doesn't evenly go into 12, and it doesn't evenly go into 11. It also doesn't evenly go into 11 dozen 11, or 11 gross 11 dozen 11. It does, however, evenly go into 11 great gross 11 gross 11 dozen 11. In dozenal, a fifth is point two four nine seven recurring because it's equal to two great gross four gross nine dozen seven eleven great gross 11 gross 11 dozen elevenths.
cues.zh: 99 可以被 9 整除，我们已经有针对 9 的整除性测试了，所以除掉这个因素后，我们剩下 11。你瞧，11 正好比 10 多 1。这在任何进制下都会发生，因为对于任意数字 n，n 的平方减 1 等于 n 加 1 乘以 n 减 1。真巧妙。回顾一下，在任何给定的进制中，都有针对该进制因数的简易整除测试，以及针对该进制邻近数字因数的可行整除测试。这不仅适用于整除性测试，也反映在有理数的表示中。在十进制中，二分之一写作点五，因为它等于十分之五。在十二进制中，二分之一写作点六，因为它等于十二分之六。在六进制中，二分之一写作点三，因为它等于六分之三。3 不能整除 10，但它能整除 9。在十进制中，三分之一写作点三循环，因为它等于九分之三。在十二进制中，三分之一写作点四，因为它等于十二分之四。在六进制中，三分之一写作点二，因为它等于六分之二。4 不能整除 10，但没关系，因为四分之一只是二分之一的一半。在十进制中，二分之一是点五，5 的一半是二点五，即 2.5。所以四分之一是点二五。在十二进制中，四分之一写作点三，因为它等于十二分之三。4 不能整除 6，但没关系，因为四分之一只是二分之一的一半。在六进制中，二分之一是点三，3 的一半是一点五，即 1.3。所以四分之一是点一三。到这里，对于哪些进制在表示有理数方面比其他进制更好，已经有一个非常清晰的排名了。十二进制最简单，用单数字就能写出这三个分数，其次是六进制，写四分之一需要两个数字，最后一名是十进制，写三分之一需要循环数字。如果我们把五分之一考虑在内，这个排名就没那么明显了。在十进制中，五分之一写作点二，因为它等于十分之二。5 不能整除 12，也不能整除 11。它也不能整除 11打 11，或者 11罗 11打 11。不过，它确实能整除 11大罗 11罗 11打 11。在十二进制中，五分之一是点二四九七循环，因为它等于二大罗四罗九打七十一大罗 11罗 11打十一分之十一。

cues.en: Five doesn't evenly go into six either, but that's because it's exactly one less than six. In seximal, one fifth is written as point one recurring, by definition. Suddenly, the question of which of these bases is best at writing fractions is far more subjective. It's now a question of whether fourths are more important than fifths.
cues.zh: 5 也不能被 6 整除，但那是因为它正好比 6 少一。在六进制中，根据定义，五分之一写作 0.1 循环。突然之间，关于这些进制中哪一种最适合写分数的争论变得主观得多了。这变成了一个关于四分之一是否比五分之一更重要的问题。

cues.en: For me, personally, I think that fifths are more important than fourths, and that it's much easier to derive fourths in seximal than it is to derive fifths in dozenal. I completely get where you're coming from if you disagree with that, but just so we're on the same page here, you're wrong. Now, why stop at fifths? There's still more to see. Six doesn't evenly go into 10, but that's fine because a sixth is just half of a third. In decimal, a third is written as point three recurring, and half of three is one and a half, 1.5. Adding all those infinite fives to all but one of those infinite ones, you get point one, then six recurring. In decimal, a sixth is written as point two because it's equal to two twelfths. In seximal, a sixth is written as point one, by definition. We're not going to stop there either, because of course seximal is good at rank sixths. No surprises there. This part, however, genuinely surprised me when I first found out about it. Seven doesn't evenly go into ten, nine, ninety nine, nine hundred ninety nine, 9999,
cues.zh: 就我个人而言，我认为五分之一比四分之一更重要，而且在六进制中推导四分之一比在十二进制中推导五分之一容易得多。如果你不同意这一点，我完全理解你的出发点，但为了让我们达成共识，我要说：你错了。那么，为什么止步于五分之一呢？还有更多内容。6 不能被 10 整除，但这没关系，因为六分之一只是三分之一的一半。在十进制中，三分之一写作 0.3 循环，3 的一半是一点五，即 1.5。把所有那些无限的 5 加到除了其中一个之外的所有无限 1 上，你就会得到 0.16，其中 6 是循环的。在十进制中，六分之一写作 0.2，因为它等于十二分之二。在六进制中，根据定义，六分之一写作 0.1。我们也不会就此停下，因为六进制当然很擅长表示六分之几。这一点毫不意外。然而，当我第一次发现这一部分时，它确实让我感到惊讶。7 不能被 10、9、99、999、9999

cues.en: or ninety nine thousand nine hundred ninety nine. It does, however, evenly go into nine hundred ninety nine thousand nine hundred ninety nine. In decimal, a seventh is written as point one four two eight five seven recurring, because it's equal to 1428579999900.1111111111111111111111111111.
7 doesn't evenly go into 1211111111

gross 11 dozen 11, 11 great gross 11 dozen 11, or 11 dozen 11 great gross 11 dozen 11. It does, however, evenly go into 11 gross 11 dozen 11 great gross 11 dozen 11. In dozenal, a seventh is written as point one eight six ten three five recurring because it's equal to one gross, eight dozen, 10 great gross, 10 gross, three dozen, five, 11 gross, 11 dozen, 11 great gross, 11 dozen, elevenths.
cues.zh: 总共 11 打 11，11 大打 11 打 11，或者 11 打 11 大打 11 打 11。不过，它可以整除 11 大打 11 打 11 大打 11 打。在十二进制中，七分之一写作点一八六十三五循环，因为它等于一打、八十二、10 大打、10 打、三十二、五、11 打、11 十二、11 大打、11 十二分之十一。

cues.en: Whew. Both of those were very complicated.
cues.zh: 呼。这两个都太复杂了。

cues.en: But we're all okay with that, because nobody ever needs to use sevenths, right? Seven doesn't evenly go into six either, and it certainly doesn't evenly go into five. The thing is, seven is one more than six, which means that it necessarily evenly goes into 55.
cues.zh: 但我们都能接受，因为根本没人需要用到七分之几，对吧？7 也无法整除 6，当然更无法整除 5。问题是，7 比 6 大 1，这意味着它必然能整除 55。

cues.en: In seximal, one seventh is written as point zero five recurring, because it's equal to five fifty fifths. Hopefully,
cues.zh: 在六进制中，七分之一写作点零五循环，因为它等于五分之五十五。希望

cues.en: you can see where I'm coming from by now. Sure, dozenal is slightly better at fourths, but at what cost? The simplest ratio that seximal really does a bad job at representing is one eleventh, which it writes as point zero three one three four five two four two one recurring. Everything simpler than elevenths needs, at most, three digits. Personally, I think we can all agree that you don't ever need to use elevenths. Part four, conclusion. By now, I'm sure you can see why I say that seximal is better than decimal and dozenal. I didn't even get into the stuff like the history of yam counting in New Guinea, or how to use base niff to make seximal numbers half the length, or even how to say numbers larger than Unixia.
cues.zh: 你现在能明白我的意思了。没错，十二进制在处理四分之一时稍好一些，但代价是什么呢？六进制在表示时表现最差的最简单比例是十一分之一，写作点零三一三四五二四二一循环。比十一分之几更简单的分数，最多只需要三位数字。个人认为，大家肯定都会同意，根本用不到十一分之一。第四部分，结论。到现在，我确信你能明白我为什么说六进制比十进制和十二进制更好了。我甚至还没讲到新几内亚红薯计数的历史，或者如何使用 niff 进制将六进制数字长度减半，甚至是如何念出比 Unixia 更大的数字。

cues.en: If you haven't been convinced, feel free to argue about it in the comment section. If anyone brings up some, like, actually good counterpoints, I might make a follow-up video about them. Anyway, until then, for more information, go over to seximal.net,

cues.en: which is a pretty much comprehensive resource on the seximal system. I've been Jan Mieseli, and I don't have a sign off for my videos that aren't about conlanging.
